ops.title: codex/sol lanes DOWN — OAuth revoked (2026-07-19)
ops.body:
During P1.5 (vault-migration plan), the workflow's gpt-5.6-sol security-refuter lane (via codex-wrapper) died with a hard auth error: `401 token_revoked` / `refresh_token_invalidated` / "Your session has ended. Please log in again." (chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex). This is NOT transient — the OAuth refresh token is revoked; codex needs an interactive `codex login` re-auth on the host.

**Impact on the plan:** every lane the Models table routes to gpt-5.6-sol (code/diff review finder+refuter, security review/audit + verification of security-sensitive code, bounded decision-light implementation fan-outs) is unavailable until re-auth. The remaining phases route heavily to sol.

**Fallback while down:** route security reviews / refuter passes to **fable** (the escalation target; tier-appropriate for verifying fable- or opus-authored work). Implementation that would have fanned to sol stays on opus. Verification of fable work by opus would violate the same-or-higher-tier rule, so keep verifiers on fable.

**To restore:** user runs `codex login` (or equivalent re-auth) on the host, then codex/sol lanes work again.
